query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 75,
  radar_freshness = 95,
  radar_warmth = 20,
  radar_sweetness = 45,
  radar_spiciness = 25,
  radar_earthiness = 15
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%citrus%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%citron%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%orange%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%bergamote%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%agrume%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%lemon%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
